title: Accurate interdomain contacts in mixed folded proteins from NMR-guided coarse-grained simulations
authors: Hobbs B; Limmer N; Clenshaw GL; Ossa F; Karamanos TK
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR引导的粗粒化模拟，在混合折叠-无序蛋白DNAJB6中准确预测结构域间接触，揭示无序GF连接子介导的互作构象，为无序蛋白PPI机制建模提供了可迁移的物理模拟方法。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered, low-complexity regions frequently cooperate with folded domains to mediate protein–protein interactions, yet accurately describing these mixed folded–disordered systems remains challenging. To visualize these mixed folded proteins, experimentally guided coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics simulations are often employed to extend the timescales required to capture the complex dynamics in play. However, the minimalistic nature of these approaches often compromises structural accuracy and can lead to inaccurate inter-domain interactions. Here we introduce backbone dihedral terms directly derived from NMR chemical shift data in CG-simulations to characterize the open state of a mixed-folded construct of the anti-aggregation chaperone DNAJB6 that contains a folded J-domain and a disordered GF linker. By tuning residue-specific backbone dihedral parameters to match NMR-derived secondary-structure propensities of the linker in CG-simulations, we generate conformational ensembles that yield accurate interdomain contact maps. In agreement with analysis of NMR relaxation data, the resulting ensembles show that even in the nominally open state the linker experiences motions that resemble those of the closed state driven by hydrophobic residues in GF. More generally we show that by expanding CG-simulations to allow them to capture both local and global structural properties, physically relevant interdomain contacts can be retrieved.
abstract_zh: 本质上无序的低复杂度区域经常与折叠结构域协同作用，以介导蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，然而准确描述这些混合的折叠-无序系统仍具挑战性。为了可视化这些混合折叠蛋白，通常采用实验引导的粗粒化（CG）分子动力学模拟，以延长捕捉复杂动态所需的时间尺度。然而，这些方法的简约性常损害结构准确性，并可能导致不准确的域间相互作用。在此，我们在CG模拟中引入直接源自NMR化学位移数据的骨架二面角项，以表征抗聚集伴侣DNAJB6的混合折叠构建体的开放状态，该构建体包含一个折叠的J结构域和一个无序的GF连接子。通过调整残基特异性骨架二面角参数，使其与CG模拟中连接子的NMR衍生二级结构倾向相匹配，我们生成了能够产生准确域间接触图的构象系综。与NMR弛豫数据分析一致，所得系综表明，即使在名义上的开放状态，连接子也经历类似于闭合状态的运动，这些运动由GF中的疏水残基驱动。更广泛地，我们表明通过扩展CG模拟以使其同时捕捉局部和全局结构特性，可以获得物理相关的域间接触。
